description: Buy a DataHub dataset (x402 settlement on Solana, 99% goes to the seller) and return the download link. Pays in USDC by default; set token to USDT to settle in USDT instead. Spending caps apply.

book_id.description: The dataset id returned by datahub_search (a uuid), not its title. Buying the same dataset twice pays twice; use datahub_download to re-fetch something already owned.

token.description: Stablecoin to pay with. The agent wallet must hold this token and a little SOL for fees. Defaults to USDC.

name: datahub_buy
